slider.s0: Current value. Pass an array to enable range mode with two thumbs.
slider.s1: Called when the value changes via drag, click, or keyboard.
slider.s4: Step increment. Thumb snaps to the nearest step during drag.
slider.s5: Discrete list of allowed values, e.g. [0.1, 0.5, 0.7, 1.1, 1.3]. The thumb snaps only to these values and arrow keys walk the list. min/max derive from the list's extremes and step is ignored.
slider.s6: Render dot indicators at each step position on the track.
slider.s7: Whether to display the current value label.
slider.s8: Position of the value label. "tooltip" shows above the thumb during interaction.
slider.s9: Custom formatter for the value label.
slider.s10: Accessible label for the slider, also shown as prefix in the value display.
slider.c1: Called when the value changes via click, drag, or keyboard.
slider.c4: Visual mode. "pips" shows discrete dot indicators. "scrubber" shows no dots — drag anywhere in the row to set a continuous value.
slider.c5: Step increment for snapping. In pips mode, also determines the number of dots rendered.
slider.c6: Label shown on the left side. Transitions from muted to foreground on hover.
slider.c7: Custom formatter for the value shown on the right.
